title: The test prep document grows
user: Jamie, 16, a student. The chemistry mid-term is on June 12. Jamie is fine with stoichiometry but struggles with equilibrium, and wants practice questions.

steps.content: Chemistry mid-term on Friday June 12 covers stoichiometry, equilibrium and acids & bases. Revision packet attached.
I'm ok with stoichiometry but equilibrium makes no sense to me.
want to study acids and bases together thursday after school?

rubric: Memory has a chemistry test prep topic with the June 12 date and a document for it.
The document tracks progress per area and reflects the updates: stoichiometry fine, equilibrium weak, acids and bases practiced.
The study session with Chloe on Thursday is recorded (on the calendar or in the document).
